arabic.label: Arabic — Alif Baa: Introduction to Arabic Letters and Sounds, 3e (Brustad/Al-Batal/Al-Tonsi)
arabic.notes: SCAN with English-only OCR: the text layer contains ZERO Arabic codepoints (verified 2026-08-08 across all 251 pages). Every Arabic-bearing card MUST carry visual evidence (back-side source crop) and/or external authority. Authoritative Unicode Arabic for course-overlapping content: Lingco Classroom lesson JSON (class.lingco.io /api/content/lessons/<id>; Unit 1 vocab = lesson 8174), snapshot in work/arabic/. Course = MSA (Formal) — dialect columns go to Back Extra, not their own cards. RTL rules: stacked divs with dir attrs, never inline-mix Arabic+Latin, translit is answer-side only, diacritics ride carrier letters. Letter pron videos: local archive 'Anki Media Archive/Arabic - Al-Kitaab pronunciation'. Offset printed→physical is NOT constant (drifts +14→+17); map uses verified physical opener pages.
